items.title: 기본법 우선 등 'AI 입법 프레임워크' 나왔다…국가AI전략위, 7개 TF 신설
items.excerpt: Korea's National AI Strategy Committee adopted the 'Korea AI Legislative Framework' at its 3rd plenary on Nov 6: amend the AI Basic Act or existing laws before writing new standalone AI laws, fill gaps in defense/national security, and boost predictability for businesses; 477 AI-related bills have been filed in the 22nd National Assembly.
items.rationale: Official national framework that sets how Korea will legislate AI (amend the Basic Act first, no new standalone laws), with 477 pending bills in scope; changes the outlook for anyone building AI in Korea.

items.title: Department of Justice Launches Super Intelligence Task Force
items.excerpt: DOJ announced its Super Intelligence (SI) Task Force (DOJ-SITF) to counter malicious use of AI and protect U.S. AI leadership, following a presidential memo last month; the administration uses 'super intelligence' as its term for AI.
items.rationale: Primary agency release: a new federal enforcement body for AI misuse, the kind of decision this section prefers to commentary.

items.title: UK ministers seek powers to investigate when AI agents are let off the leash
items.excerpt: A new clause added at Lords third reading of the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill would let ministers regulate how essential-service operators and digital providers deploy agentic AI, require incident reports when safeguards fail, and enable searches, seizures and inspections.
items.rationale: New government clause at Lords third reading giving ministers powers to regulate agentic AI deployment and require incident reports; directly affects anyone deploying AI agents in UK essential services.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns
items.excerpt: House Republican chairs Moolenaar, Mast and Crawford sent a letter asking Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to brief Congress on his ties to an executive at Singapore cloud firm Megaspeed, previously scrutinized for possible AI-chip smuggling to China; Nvidia rejects the claims.
items.rationale: Geopolitics axis: a formal congressional letter on AI-chip smuggling concerns. The claims are attributed to the committee chairs, and Nvidia's denial is included.

items.title: 'Defamatory, attack on woman's dignity': Delhi HC orders takedown of CM's AI videos shared by AAP
items.excerpt: The Delhi High Court ordered AAP and intermediaries including X and Meta to take down AI-generated videos and a deepfake depicting Delhi CM Rekha Gupta as a liquor vendor, calling them defamatory and an attack on a woman's dignity.
items.rationale: Elections/political-communication axis: a court ruling that orders a political party and platforms to take down AI deepfakes of a sitting chief minister. It is a separate case from the 11-06 Kriti Sanon ruling.

https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/20.new_action: New clause added to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill at Lords third reading, giving ministers powers to regulate agentic-AI deployment, require incident reports and carry out inspections/seizures (the 10-28 card covered report-stage votes on AISI review and a defeated frontier-AI amendment).
